notes: SERVER + DB + CLIENT. Ƒbay title trading: collectible custom titles can now be listed, bought, and sold between players, inside the existing Ƒbay inventory marketplace. Pick the 👑 Titles category in the Ƒbay slot filter to browse titles For Sale (shown in their color with rarity) and your own listings; the + List form then lists one of your held titles at a price. Listing escrows the title out of your holdings until it sells or you delist; buying transfers cash and the title atomically with the full price going to the seller; rarity (common/rare/epic/legendary/custom) is shown for collector value. Adds a title_market table and a boot-safe schema step. Carries 1.1.8.3 and earlier.
